description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mailawalana, Dompe D/S/Division Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.511000 (24/0311)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land and property-related matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
